items.html: *We shall now explain in detail the discernment of the Rosh of AA, according to what was explained in the first chapter of Sifra deTzniuta, and this is its language: "A secret within a secret was prepared and made ready in one skull, filled with the dew of bdellium," etc. The explanation of the matter: Atik Yomin, which is the most concealed Partzuf in Atzilut, while clothing within another secret, which is AA, was made ready — meaning, was found and attained — by being corrected in these corrections of the Rosh of AA. For the corrections, the hairs, and the limbs of the Partzuf are what diminish the great light of Atik, so that we can attain it and it can be attained and found with the lower ones. For all these corrections of the Rosh of AA clothe Atik, which clothes within them.
